input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my phone. I haven’t been able to send those picture messages—MMS, I think they’re called—for the past few hours. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

I can see that my phone shows a strong signal and says "5G" at the top, but there’s a little icon that looks like mobile data is turned off. I’m not sure if that means I’m connected to mobile data or not. 

As for calls and regular texts, I haven’t noticed any issues with those—they seem to be working fine. What should I do next?
Okay, I’ve turned on the mobile data like you said. I tried to send a picture message again, but it still won’t go through. What should I do now?

I checked the APN settings like you asked, and it looks like there isn’t any MMSC URL listed there. I’m not really sure what that means—does that explain why my picture messages aren’t working? What should I do next?
I’ve reset the APN settings as you suggested. I’m a bit nervous about restarting my phone though—will I lose any of my photos or messages if I do that? I really don’t want to lose anything important.

Alright, I went ahead and restarted my phone like you said. I tried sending a picture message again, but it still isn’t working. Is there something else we can try? I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—this is all a bit much for me.
I checked, and Wi-Fi Calling is turned off on my phone. I’m also not connected to Wi-Fi right now—just using mobile data. What should I try next?
I checked the permissions for my messaging app, and it already has access to both storage and SMS. Is there anything else I should try? I really hope we can get this fixed soon.

Oh, I see. That explains it! I’d like to add more data so I can send my pictures. Could you please add 2GB for me? And just to double-check, that will be $4.00 total, right? I want to make sure before we go ahead.
Yes, please go ahead and add the 2GB for $4.00. I’d really appreciate it—thank you for helping me through all of this!
It looks like I don’t see any payment request yet. Is there something I need to do on my end to get this started, or will you send the payment request to me?
I just tried sending a picture message again, but it still isn’t working. Is there something else I need to do now that I have more data? I’m starting to get a bit worried—will this ever work again?
I restarted my phone again like you said, but I still can’t send picture messages. Is there anything else we can try? I’m really starting to feel overwhelmed by all of this.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

Could you please check your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings? This will help us see if the settings for sending MMS are correct.

Thank you for checking. Yes, the missing MMSC URL in your APN settings is likely the reason why your picture messages (MMS) aren’t working. The MMSC URL is required for sending and receiving MMS.

Here’s what you should do next:
1. Reset your APN settings to the default values. This will restore the correct MMSC URL and other necessary settings.
2. After resetting the APN, please reboot (restart) your phone for the changes to take effect.
